bl_r2: career SOE, leave-one-class-out: baseline held-out R2
bl_r2_lo: baseline held-out R2: 90% lower, class-stratified bootstrap
bl_rmse: career SOE, leave-one-class-out: baseline RMSE, in
calh_pct: held-out forecasts of 60%+ (all rounds): observed hit rate, %
clip_douglas_1_v: douglas clip 1: speed at the slowest point of the cut, yd/s
clip_douglas_2_v: douglas clip 2: speed at the slowest point of the cut, yd/s
clip_douglas_3_sep: douglas clip 3: separation at the throw, yd
clip_washington_1_v: washington clip 1: speed at the slowest point of the cut, yd/s
clip_washington_2_v: washington clip 2: speed at the slowest point of the cut, yd/s
clip_washington_3_sep: washington clip 3: separation at the throw, yd
cr_per_yd: catch-rate points per yard of separation
d3_boot_p: share of receiver-clustered bootstrap resamples with a day-3 gain at or below zero (one-sided)
d3_neff: effective independent day-3 pairs (20 / design effect)
d3c_p: day-3 gain: receiver-clustered shuffle p (models fixed, day-3 receivers' own SOE shuffled), one-sided
dr2: career SOE, leave-one-class-out: Break G increment, delta R2
dr2_hi: Break G increment, delta R2: 90% upper
dr2_lo: Break G increment, delta R2: 90% lower, class-stratified bootstrap
eb_noise: % of a 200-route season's SOE that is noise
eb_sig: % of a 200-route season's SOE that is signal (weight kept by the shrinkage)
eq_tost: TOST p at +/-3 in (larger of the two bootstrap arms)
eq_up_p: bootstrap share of Break G slopes at or above +3 in (benefit arm)
ev_all_drho: all: gain of the SOE forecast over pick and routes (drho)
ev_d3_drho: d3: gain of the SOE forecast over pick and routes (drho)
f3_cover: families whose top-speed gap interval spans 0
f3_hitch: hitch: speed at the top, top minus bottom third, yd/s
fp_pool_med: All five (pooled): posterior median true drill-to-NFL correlation
fp_pool_p02: All five (pooled): posterior % that the true link exceeds 0.2
g_sd: 1 sd of Break G = sd of true receiver Break G, in g
l26_douglas_pc1: Demario Douglas: recalibrated P(2026 SOE > 0), SOE forecast
l26_johnson_pc1: Tez Johnson: recalibrated P(2026 SOE > 0), SOE forecast
l26_smith_pc1: Arian Smith: recalibrated P(2026 SOE > 0), SOE forecast
l26_washington_pc1: Malik Washington: recalibrated P(2026 SOE > 0), SOE forecast
lopo_max: leave-one-pair-out day-3 gain: largest of the 20
lopo_min: leave-one-pair-out day-3 gain: smallest of the 20
n_main: 116 WR/TE with a drill score and NFL routes
nc_g: day-3 rank-correlation gain, draft-class folds, shrinkage nested
nc_lo: draft-class folds, shrinkage nested: 90% lower, receiver-clustered
nn_b: Without Puka Nacua, the most influential player: inches of season SOE per sd of Break G
nn_hi: Without Puka Nacua, the most influential player: 90% upper
nn_lo: Without Puka Nacua, the most influential player: 90% lower
ns_g: day-3 rank-correlation gain, season folds, shrinkage nested
ns_lo: season folds, shrinkage nested: 90% lower, receiver-clustered
nv_g: day-3 rank-correlation gain, rule vs naive raw last-season SOE
nv_hi: rule vs naive raw last-season SOE: 90% upper
nv_lo: rule vs naive raw last-season SOE: 90% lower, receiver-clustered
perm_rho_p: permutation p of the rank-correlation gain
price_bg: clubs pay % earlier pick per sd of Break G
prim_b: Pre-specified forecast (primary): inches of season SOE per sd of Break G
qb_b: SOE adjusted for quarterback: inches of season SOE per sd of Break G
rdg_r2: ridge baseline, held-out R2 (leave one class out)
rel_mm3: reliability, second rep on three drills

sel_out: excluded: no NFL routes with separation
sesoi_catch: +3 in is worth 0.44 catches a season
sha26: first 12 characters of the sha256 of the frozen 2026 rule
sim_pow: simulated power of the 2026 test (true gain = observed, N26 pairs)

sl_smith_slot: Arian Smith: % of sampled 2025 snaps lined up in the slot

sp_douglas_zone: Demario Douglas: mean snap SOE, zone, in

sp_washington_zone: Malik Washington: mean snap SOE, zone, in
spd_rho: speed benchmark, snap-to-throw window on breaking snaps: official 40 vs NFL top speed
spdf_n: receivers with 8+ sampled snaps and an official 40 (full-play window)
spdf_rho: official 40 vs NFL top speed, full-play max (90th pct of per-snap max), rank corr
spdr_rho: raw official 40 (WR and TE pooled) vs full-play NFL top speed, rank corr
t5_ipw_b: Re-weighted for who reaches the NFL sample: slope, in per sd

tb_all_catch: SOE rule's cost of being wrong, catches a season
tb_all_cost: SOE for every contrast: mean shortfall when wrong, in

tb_cost_pick: earlier pick: mean shortfall when wrong, in

why_apy: median contract APY of 2025 day-3/UDFA WR/TE with 100+ routes, $M
